notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
BUG!!!? WHAT!!!

Yeah there were some bugs... I will describe it to you.

There was a [b]sound effect missing [/b]and the computer and game could not even remember what it was for... (WHERE IS THE SOUND EFFECT YOU PUT IN THE GAME) it said to me. 
"Well I put the sound effect in the game, it should be part of the package. The depot. The build."
The game did not want to cooperate, and I had to terminate this ghost sound effect altogether. Computers do indeed have little lives of their own.

You will get [b]punched for making a nice silly deal[/b]. NO DEAL!!! I fixed the game so you could have successful deal.

[b]The Cheevos....[/b]
The cheevos are very important and some of them didn't pop up. They...still might not because they are very finnicky with your success. It is true, they told me this morning they might not be able to take it in time for everyones achievement ceremonies. I told them that's the business. They were hesitant, and sort of shrugged it off. Hard dealing with celebrities.

Anyway, those were the bugs this time. As mentioned before, thank you to the company of Abbock and Tamago for being part of this small little bug finding. This game is not perfect, and isn't meant to be..but those were things that immediately impacted little events in the game. Good night. Respect the craft, and, welcome to the Game.
